task.title: Parse comma-separated scores
task.task_summary: Convert a comma-separated string of integer scores into a list of integers.
task.expected_behavior: Ignore surrounding whitespace and empty fields, and return the remaining fields as integers in their original order.

student_code:
def parse_scores(text):
    return [int(part.strip()) for part in text.split(',') if part.strip()]

task.title: Reverse a dictionary
task.task_summary: Implement reverse_dict to create a new dictionary that swaps each input key and value.
task.expected_behavior: For a mapping with unique values, return a new mapping from each original value to its original key.

student_code:

    return {value: key for key, value in dictionary.items()}
